process EPANG_FILTERQUERY {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
?         'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/06/0600fdb9287986d3d684b95d6e94f597c41b24a746608532d7c0836bd7b44c15/data'
:         'community.wave.seqera.io/library/gawk_gzip:fe0c202000bc8ed4' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(reference, stageAs: 'reference/*'), path(query, stageAs: 'query/*'), val(min_query_columns), val(min_reference_coverage)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.query.fasta.gz"), emit: query, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.filterquery.tsv"), emit: table
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('gawk'), eval("awk -Wversion | sed '1!d; s/.*Awk //; s/,.*//'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_gawk

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    assert min_query_columns as Integer >= 1 : "EPANG_FILTERQUERY: min_query_columns must be at least 1, the lowest value EPA-ng accepts (got ${min_query_columns})"
    assert (min_reference_coverage as BigDecimal) >= 0 && (min_reference_coverage as BigDecimal) <= 1 : "EPANG_FILTERQUERY: min_reference_coverage must be between 0 and 1 (got ${min_reference_coverage})"
    template 'filterquery.sh'

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    echo "" | gzip > ${prefix}.query.fasta.gz
    printf 'query\\treference_columns\\tquery_columns\\treference_coverage\\tkept\\n' > ${prefix}.filterquery.tsv
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/epang/filterquery"
description: "Drop query sequences that have too few residues in the occupied columns\
  \ of the reference alignment, before EPA-ng placement"
keywords:
- "epa-ng"
- "phylogenetic placement"
- "alignment"
- "filter"
- "fasta"
tools:
- gawk:
    description: "GNU awk"
    homepage: "https://www.gnu.org/software/gawk/"
    documentation: "https://www.gnu.org/software/gawk/manual/"
    tool_dev_url: "https://www.gnu.org/prep/ftp.html"
    licence:
    - "GPL v3"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - reference:
      type: "file"
      description: "Aligned reference sequences in FASTA format, gzipped or not. A\
        \ column\nis occupied when at least one reference sequence has a residue in\
        \ it; gaps are `-`\nand `.`, and also `?`, `N` and `n` when the reference\
        \ is nucleotide. It is taken to be\nnucleotide when at least 90% of its non-gap\
        \ characters are A, C, G, T, U or N (either\ncase), otherwise protein, where\
        \ `N` is asparagine. EPA-ng drops the unoccupied columns.\n"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,afa,aln}{,.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - query:
      type: "file"
      description: "Query sequences aligned to the reference, in FASTA format, gzipped\
        \ or\nnot, with the same number of columns as `reference`.\n"
      pattern: "*.{fasta,fa,afa,aln}{,.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  - min_query_columns:
      type: "integer"
      description: "The minimum number of residues a query must have in occupied columns.\n\
        At least 1, the lowest value EPA-ng accepts. A query is also dropped when\
        \ it has no\nunambiguous residue in them, since EPA-ng reads `?`, `N`, `X`\
        \ and `O` (either case) as\ngaps and aborts on a query with nothing else,\
        \ whatever this threshold is.\n"
  - min_reference_coverage:
      type: "float"
      description: "The minimum fraction of the occupied columns that a query must\
        \ have a\nresidue in, between 0 and 1. 0 turns this filter off.\n"
output:
  query:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.query.fasta.gz':
        type: "file"
        description: "The queries that passed both thresholds, gzipped aligned FASTA.\
          \ Not\nwritten when no query passes, since an empty file makes EPA-ng fail.\n"
        pattern: "*.query.fasta.gz"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
  table:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.filterquery.tsv':
        type: "file"
        description: "One row per query with the columns `query`, `reference_columns`\
          \ (the\nnumber of occupied columns), `query_columns` (residues of the query\
          \ in\nthem), `reference_coverage` (the ratio of the two), `unambiguous_columns`\
          \ (the\nnumber of those columns where the query has a residue other than\
          \ `?`, `N`, `X`\nand `O`, either case) and `kept` (`true` or `false`).\n"
        pattern: "*.filterquery.tsv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  versions_gawk:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - gawk:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - awk -Wversion | sed '1!d; s/.*Awk //; s/,.*//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - gawk:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - awk -Wversion | sed '1!d; s/.*Awk //; s/,.*//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
